displayName: Weekly review: agent report quality BELOW FLOOR

documentation.content: The Monday weekly review (Cloud Run job gameday-weekly-review) had the LLM judge grade last week's real gameday reports, and their mean quality (0-100) came in under QUALITY_FLOOR. The `WEEKLY REVIEW BELOW FLOOR` log line has the score; the Discord post and Firestore eval_weekly/{season}-w{NN} have the per-criterion scores and the two lowest reports with the judge's reasons.
